intro: Fairborn sits at the intersection of Wright-Patterson Air Force Base and Wright State University — and its housing shows it. Older neighborhoods near the base feature mid-century homes with aging plumbing and flat-roof additions that pond water and leak. Near Wright State, heavy student-rental turnover means deferred maintenance: slow leaks behind walls, under sinks, and in bathrooms that go unreported for semesters at a time. Downtown Fairborn's older commercial-residential mix adds its own aging-roof attic mold calls.
